title: Google, Blackstone launch cloud company as Wall Street races to fund AI boom
title_zh: 华尔街竞相资助人工智能热潮，谷歌和黑石成立云公司
summary: The two giants are launching an AI compute supplier as the demand for AI infrastructure continues to grow.
summary_zh: 随着对人工智能基础设施的需求持续增长，两大巨头正在推出人工智能计算供应商。

title: Google, Blackstone to launch AI cloud venture to meet data centre demand
title_zh: 谷歌和黑石将推出人工智能云合资企业以满足数据中心需求
summary: Alphabet's Google and Blackstone said on Monday that they will form an artificial ‌intelligence cloud business venture aimed at capitalising on an insatiable demand ‌for AI computing services.
summary_zh: Alphabet 旗下的谷歌和 Blackstone 周一表示，他们将组建一家人工智能云业务企业，旨在利用对人工智能计算服务永不满足的需求。

title: Google, Blackstone to create new AI cloud company, WSJ reports
title_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，谷歌和黑石将创建新的人工智能云公司
summary: May 18 (Reuters) - Alphabet's Google and Blackstone plan to launch an artificial-intelligence cloud company using Google's specialized chips, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing sources
summary_zh: 5 月 18 日（路透社）——《华尔街日报》周一援引消息人士的话报道称，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌和 Blackstone 计划推出一家使用谷歌专用芯片的人工智能云公司

title: Meta Moves 7,000 Workers Into AI Roles Ahead of Job Cuts
title_zh: Meta 在裁员之前将 7,000 名员工调入人工智能岗位
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. is reassigning 7,000 workers to new jobs related to artificial intelligence, according to an internal memo, part of a broad corporate restructuring that includes planned staff reductions later this week.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——根据一份内部备忘录，Meta Platforms Inc. 正在将 7,000 名员工重新分配到与人工智能相关的新岗位，这是广泛的公司重组的一部分，其中包括计划在本周晚些时候裁员。

title: US stocks end mixed as tech stocks slide, Treasury yields climb
title_zh: 美股收盘涨跌互现，科技股下滑，国债收益率攀升
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended mixed on Monday, with the Dow adding about a third of a percent, the S&P 500 little changed and the tech-heavy Nasdaq shedding half a percent.Ongoing worries about the disruption of oil supplies, inflation and elevated borrowing costs we...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周一收盘涨跌互现，道琼斯指数上涨约三分之一，标准普尔 500 指数几乎没有变化，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 0.5%。我们对石油供应中断、通货膨胀和借贷成本上升的持续担忧...

title: Anthropic to let partners share Mythos cybersecurity findings with others
title_zh: Anthropic 让合作伙伴与其他人分享 Mythos 网络安全发现
summary: Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities.
summary_zh: Anthropic 周一表示，它正在修改其先前的立场，以允许其 Mythos 网络安全模型的用户与可能面临类似漏洞的其他人共享有关网络威胁的信息。

title: Trump Announces Discount Drug Pricing Expansion With Mark Cuban
title_zh: 特朗普与马克·库班宣布扩大药品折扣定价

summary_zh: （彭博社）——唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布，他的政府将与亿万富翁马克·库班一起在其直接面向消费者的药品销售网站 TrumpRx 上添加 600 多种仿制药。彭博社的大多数读者美国立法者计划对电动汽车拥有者收取 130 美元的新费用...

title: Berkshire is extra bullish on Delta, Alphabet as CEO adjusts portfolio
title_zh: 随着首席执行官调整投资组合，伯克希尔格外看好达美航空和Alphabet
summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B) has adjusted its equity portfolio under new CEO Greg Abel, including a new $2.6 billion stake in Delta Air Lines (DAL) while tripling the firm's stake in Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL).
summary_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司（BRK-A、BRK-B）在新任首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔（Greg Abel）的领导下调整了其股票投资组合，其中包括以 26 亿美元的价格持有达美航空（DAL）的新股份，同时将公司在 Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）的股份增加两倍。

title: SpaceX eyes 5-for-1 stock split as IPO takes shape
title_zh: 随着 IPO 的形成，SpaceX 计划进行 1 拆 5 的股票分割
summary: Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Market Domination to discuss SpaceX's (SPAX.PVT)5-for-1 stock split as IPO timeline accelerates.
summary_zh: 随着 IPO 时间表的加快，高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 与 Market Domination 一起讨论 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 的 5 股拆股计划。
